For the first 10 weeks of his new job, Bill’s take-home
pay was $200 a week. Each week he put $30 in a
savings plan. His take-home pay increased to $240
beginning with the 11 th week, and he increased his
weekly contribution to the savings plan so that it was
the same percent of his take-home pay as before. How
much did Bill contribute to the savings plan from his
pay for the first 21 weeks on the job?
